identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase 1/2 Study of 177Lu-NYM032 Injection in mCRPC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1/2 Study to Evaluate the Safety, Pharmacokinetics, Radiation Dosimetry and Efficacy of 177Lu-NYM032 Injection in Patients With PSMA-Positive Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: 177Lu-NYM032 injection is a radioligand therapeutic agent that targets prostate specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-expressing prostate tumors. NYM032 is a small molecular with strong affinity for PSMA.

interventions.name: 177Lu-NYM032 injection
interventions.description: Radionuclide 177Lu will be used as a therapeutic nuclide for this study. The precursor of NYM032 will be labeled with 177Lu to form the chelation product, 177Lu-NYM032 injection which will be used in this study as a intravenous injection dose of 177Lu-NYM032. The radiation dose is chosen within the range of 50-200 mCi for an individual patient at every dose.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Patients With Dose Limiting Toxicity (DLT)
primaryOutcomes.description: Dose limiting toxicity is determined by monitoring for adverse events following therapy.
Maximum tolerated dose (MTD) is determined by monitoring dose-limiting toxicity and adverse events in the dosing cohorts
